scope: Two separate externally driven component experiments; no end-to-end token throughput
statistics: Median and min/max across two independent processes per condition; locality first averages four mutations within each process; no confidence interval

environmentCoverage.attention: All four top-level environment keys are required, non-null and compared across all eight cases.
environmentCoverage.locality: Earlier locality records lack Python/platform/package/fixture-seed metadata; matching source hashes, browser/version/arguments and active-input hash are checked. Missing environment metadata is not evidence of environment identity.
